race.comment: BULLRUN (2) brings the most reliable current pointer after resuming with a second at Emerald, and while this is a stronger assignment than that picnic-grade return, he has already placed at the distance and gets a suitable maiden to press on with. GRAPHIEN (5) has a more forgiving last-start profile than the margin suggests, having been slow away and wide throughout at Aramac, while her prior Rockhampton run was far more competitive. EARLY EDITION (9) resumes from a break and his Carrathool second reads well enough for this, though the drop back from 1200m to 1000m is the main reservation. SAINT ANNS (12) is the steadier each-way option: she has placed regularly, won an easy MacKay trial and has enough recent substance to be competitive fresh, but her 1000m record keeps her just behind the top trio.
